audio.text: Should we take the bus or walk to the career center?

options: The career center can help you with your résumé.
I took the bus to the airport last month.
Yes, we should go there together.
Let's walk; it's a nice day and it isn't far.

why.en: Choice question → a choice with a reason. A describes the place; B repeats "took the bus" about another trip; C answers "Yes" to an either/or question.
why.tr: Seçim sorusu → gerekçeli bir seçim. A yeri anlatıyor; B "took the bus" ifadesini başka bir yolculuk için tekrar ediyor; C "ya o ya bu" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: Pregunta de elección → una elección con un motivo. A describe el lugar; B repite "took the bus" sobre otro viaje; C responde "Yes" a una pregunta de "esto o aquello".
